## Result — Highest growth phase between 2000 BCE and 1100 BCE

**Hypothesis.** Within the 1900–1100 BCE portion of the supplied window (nine complete 100-year centuries, evaluated with binning convention C1 = `|CE| // 100`), the highest-growth century is **1400 BCE**, identified by the largest mean `pollen_grate_100` (≈ +0.193 %/yr, i.e., 0.001931 fractional), the largest single-year spike (≈ +0.46 % at CE ≈ −1415 BCE), and the largest contemporaneous mean of the KDE growth-rate series `g_all_mean` (= +0.00284). The most defensible *sustained* high-growth phase is the contiguous pair **1300 BCE – 1400 BCE**, the only consecutive centuries in which both `pollen_grate_100` (mean +0.00111, +0.00193) and `g_all_mean` (mean +0.00142, +0.00284) are jointly positive — discrepant only in direction at neighboring centuries (e.g. 1500 BCE is strongly negative on the pollen signal). The capital.csv 12-capital Zmean composite independently peaks at 1400 BCE (+0.94) and declines at 1500 BCE (+0.26), directionally confirming — but not overriding — the pollen call. Under the alternative C2 binning (`ceil(|CE|/100)`), the peak label shifts to "1500 BCE"; both conventions identify the same physical ≈100-year span (CE ≈ −1500 to −1400), so the conclusion is robust to the labelling choice. All conclusions are derived from interpolated / 100-year-smoothed signals, since raw pollen and raw capital-Z columns are ~95 % NaN inside the window.

payload.workflow: 1. Loaded the three CSVs (decimal="," for capital.csv). 2. Filtered time_series_data to CE ∈ [−2000, −1100] and dropped the 1-row "century-20" bin. 3. Aggregated nine complete centuries (1900–1100 BCE) by mean pollen_grate_100, mean g_all_mean and net Δ pollen_inter. 4. Ranked centuries — clear peak at 1400 BCE (mean = 0.001931). 5. Identified the sustained phase as the longest contiguous run above the window-mean pollen_grate_100 of −0.000147: 1300–1400 BCE. 6. Ran a C2 sensitivity check; under C2 the peak label shifts to "1500 BCE", but both labels describe the same physical ~100-y span. 7. Cross-checked with capital.csv 12-capital Zmean — peaks at 1400 BCE (+0.94), directionally aligned.
